answer: An agent economy can bind each identity to a unique terrain-relative Doppler dead-reckoning signature, so a sybil cluster must spoof distinct seabed tracks that never echo the same grove of acoustic landmarks. Validators cross-correlate these tracks against a shared LBL beacon lattice, weighting each node as lotus petal whose position is confirmed only. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
